name: Moe Mama! ~Cutie Mama Came Suddenly...~
original_name: もえママ! ～Cutie MaMa came Suddenly…～
source:
Main character lives alone due to parents circumstances, so he has a longing for family harmony. His female childhood friend becomes really popular at school, so he feels inferiority compared to her. 
One day he returns home and discovers a cute little girl waiting for him.
"Welcome home, Ma-kun! Dinner will be ready soon".
She asks to call her Mama. But what is she wearing - is it possibly the legendary naked apron?
Ordinary everyday suddenly turns into extraordinary burst of moe.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-april-2006-tenshitsuki-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角因父母的原因独自生活，因此渴望家庭和睦。他的青梅竹马在学校很受欢迎，所以与她相比，他感到自卑。
有一天，他回到家，发现一个可爱的小女孩在等他。
“欢迎回家，马君！晚饭马上就准备好了。”
她要求叫她妈妈。但她穿的是什么——难道是传说中的裸围裙？
平凡的日常突然变得不平凡的萌爆。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-april-2006-tenshitsuki-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
